# Scaffold All Docker Services

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docker.generate-all` |
| Source | `02_core/runtimes/yaml/definitions/docker.yaml` |
| Tags | docker, workflow |

Iterates `runtime.catalog.definitions` for every concrete docker
service (any definition tagged `docker` but not `abstract`) and
invokes it, scaffolding the per-service files under `output_root`.
Mirrors the `launchd.generate-plist` workflow.

### Run Operations

#### Invoke every concrete docker service

_No operation description provided._

```invoke
invoke:
  definition: '{{ definition.id }}'
  arguments:
    target_dir: '{{ output_root }}/{{ definition.id | replace(''docker.'', '''') }}'
for_each:
  items: runtime.catalog.definitions | selectattr('has_docker') | list
  as: definition
```
